name: notebook-slides
description: Plan and build NotebookLM-quality slide decks: outline, a theme designed from scratch for the content, per-page designs, then one finished image per slide delivered as a single PDF.

interface.longDescription: Turns your chat, notes, and uploaded files into a slide deck at the design level of NotebookLM. It works in three checkpoints you approve: an outline with the content of every page, a master theme designed from scratch for your subject, and a detailed design of each page. Then it renders every slide as a finished 16:9 image and combines them into one PDF.
capabilities: Design a custom theme per deck
defaultPrompt: Make a slide deck from these notes.
Turn the attached report into a 12-slide presentation.
Make a 10-slide deck about octopus intelligence.
